text_block_list.text:
Although it's time for her training
session, Biwa
Hayahide hasn't shown up,
so I decide to search
for her.
Hehehe... I'm so glad you asked.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There’s a salon that's holding a special
promotion
to help tame "extremely
voluminous hair," so I
tried it out!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I had five millimeters taken off, and it's
really
helped reduce wind resistance! I'm
sure today's
training will be—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Um, it's a bit late for that.

text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness! When did it get so
late?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I was so focused on short-term

improvement that I lost sight of my

responsibilities!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She seems genuinely sorry, so I tell her
to take
the day off and come back
tomorrow for training.
